Standard: Any material that is loosed in the airstream during operation of the escape system (e.g., transparencies, hatches, fragments, blast debris) do not cause blunt force injury to the crewmember. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing is accomplished to verify that debris from the ejection does not cause blunt force injury to the crewmember.
